versions.changelog: Make the ClawHub skill README/body English-first.
Add bilingual README and switch ClawHub skill description to English.
Harden public setup paths, remove personal defaults, and document safe Google OAuth configuration.
Remove embedded OAuth credentials and read secrets from environment/keychain.

- Initial release of Meeting Assistant for macOS: complete meeting workflow automation from calendar/window detection to minute generation and push.
- Native system audio and microphone recording using ScreenCaptureKit and AVFoundation, with no need for virtual sound cards.
- Automatic meeting detection and recording prompts, including WeChat, Tencent Meeting, Google Meet, Zoom, and Feishu.
- Integrated local audio transcription via whisper-cli (C++ version), and automatic meeting summary generation with OpenClaw agent.
- End-to-end automation: calendar integration, notifications, half-duplex mixing, floating recording status window, and multi-platform summary delivery.
- Simple interactive installation, dedicated macOS permissions guide, and robust fault tolerance built-in.
